description:
## Disposition

This ticket is closed as a rejected architecture, not as a shipped intrinsic subsystem. Do not use its old implementation, revive intrinsic syntax, or make it a prerequisite for new work.

## Current authority

fz-5xp.30 owns the approved ordinary-private-extern cutover: source-owned semantic contracts, exact real runtime exports, typed scalar/boolean lanes, C scalar-pair aggregate returns adapted into existing Fz return lanes, total arithmetic, one arithmetic_error -> panic(:badarith) helper, and validated native arithmetic substitution. Optimizing a call to a real export is allowed; inventing a source-name-driven pseudo-extern or a second semantic descriptor authority is not.

fz-5xp.32 follows .30 to complete the physical export manifest. fz-5xp.20 then owns ordinary-wrapper inlining; fz-kdt.28 owns the later replacement of the fatal arithmetic helper with proper exceptions. Read those current descriptions, not historical comments or rejected PR #148, for execution instructions.

There is no remaining dependency from this rejected ticket to .32. No code, new commit, or implementation closure is required for this disposition update.
title: Rejected intrinsic subsystem; retained FFI work belongs to fz-5xp.30
